title: Dhemaji
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
body:
Dhemaji, in north-east Assam, is one of the state's most flood-prone districts, where Himalayan rivers meet the Brahmaputra.

Floods

Rivers like the Jiadhal and Gainadi change course and flood large areas every monsoon, shaping the district's agriculture, roads and embankment policy.

People and links

The district is home to Mising, Bodo, Assamese and other communities. The Bogibeel Bridge (opened 2018) finally gave Dhemaji a direct rail and road link to Dibrugarh across the Brahmaputra.
